title: 2.3.2 Data Science Applications and Privacy
description: Cross-sector data science applications, privacy dilemmas, data anonymization, generalization, and Internet of Things (IoT) from Grade 11 ICT Section 2.3.

questions.question: How is data science used to optimize manufacturing operations?
options: Forecasts product demand to determine precise raw material purchase orders
Replaces industrial conveyor belts with manual pushcarts on factory floors
Eliminates quality assurance inspections during manufacturing assembly
Estimates utility water billing without examining municipal pipe meters
questions.correctAnswer: Forecasts product demand to determine precise raw material purchase orders

questions.question: What is the primary role of data science algorithms on social media platforms?
options: Achieving personalized information delivery from massive user activity data
Erasing all user accounts and profile histories at the close of every month
Blocking users from clicking outbound hyperlinks to external web pages
Converting color photographs into low-resolution black-and-white graphics
questions.correctAnswer: Achieving personalized information delivery from massive user activity data

questions.question: How does data science contribute directly to the agricultural sector?
options: Delivers accurate meteorological weather predictions for crop planning
Synthesizes artificial plastic tractor chassis components locally
Cancels the biological requirement for natural water in cereal crops
Automates the legal registration of ancestral rural land property deeds
questions.correctAnswer: Delivers accurate meteorological weather predictions for crop planning

questions.question: In the healthcare sector, which medical approach is enhanced through data science?
options: Preventive medicine that identifies disease risk factors before onset
Increasing administrative billing penalties for emergency clinic visits
Eliminating sterile hygiene protocols across operating surgical wards
Replacing licensed physician care with commercial retail advertisements
questions.correctAnswer: Preventive medicine that identifies disease risk factors before onset

questions.question: How do commercial business organizations apply data science techniques?
options: Risk management to identify and mitigate operational hazards
Manual bookkeeping using paper journals and ledger notebooks
Stationing armed security personnel outside branch cash vaults
Sorting physical invoice receipts into alphabetical cardboard bins
questions.correctAnswer: Risk management to identify and mitigate operational hazards

questions.question: Why does widespread user data collection on social media generate regulatory tension?
options: It clashes directly with strict user privacy laws and protection mandates
It causes severe electrical blackouts across municipal power distribution grids
It prevents students from accessing educational websites during school days
It corrupts computer operating system kernels through network data traffic
questions.correctAnswer: It clashes directly with strict user privacy laws and protection mandates

questions.question: What does Data Anonymization involve in privacy protection?
options: Removing personally identifiable information from collected data sets
Grouping individual records into broad geographical and age categories
Copying sensitive databases onto unencrypted external USB thumb drives
Restricting internet access to registered corporate network employees
questions.correctAnswer: Removing personally identifiable information from collected data sets

questions.question: What is Data Generalization in the context of data privacy?
options: Bunching data into broad categories such as age groups and territories
Deleting all numeric columns from a relational database table permanently
Translating regional languages into standardized international English
Removing physical cooling fans from high-density computer server racks
questions.correctAnswer: Bunching data into broad categories such as age groups and territories

questions.question: What is the primary operational trade-off of applying anonymization and generalization?
options: They limit the depth of insight and precision companies extract from data
They induce immediate hardware wear on internal motherboard power regulators
They permanently corrupt the underlying database relational table indexes
They require specialized line conditioners to maintain uninterrupted power
questions.correctAnswer: They limit the depth of insight and precision companies extract from data

questions.question: What is the Internet of Things (IoT) as defined in the unit key terms?
options: Interrelated Internet-connected objects exchanging data without human intervention
A global network of academic libraries cataloging historical paper manuscripts
A collection of relational database queries authored within Microsoft Access
A suite of antivirus utilities scanning desktop computers for email worms
questions.correctAnswer: Interrelated Internet-connected objects exchanging data without human intervention

questions.question: How is Social Media defined in the unit key terms?
options: A medium that facilitates socializing through virtual networks
A physical bulletin board posted in municipal community offices
A telecommunications cable providing power to server centers
An automated assembly robot deployed in car manufacturing plants
questions.correctAnswer: A medium that facilitates socializing through virtual networks
